description: This is a CMake module script for finding and configuring the LibGlib library, including locating headers and libraries, and setting relevant variables for use in build configurations.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds and loads the specified package, in this case PkgConfig.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a package using pkg-config, here for glib-2.0.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Locates header files such as 'glib.h' and 'glibconfig.h' in specified include directories.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the library file for glib-2.0.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles the standard logic for verifying that required components are found.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets variables for include directories and libraries.
